objective: Define explicit enterprise reliability policy that gates mutation certification on quantifiable invariants.
policy: If ANY minimum threshold fails, mutation certification is DENIED — never a partial certification.
If population completeness drops below 95%, M45.14 probe is re-run and root-caused before continuation.
If resume_success_rate < 100%, M45.6 must be re-qualified.
Mutation score threshold (80%) is the ONLY field that can be relaxed with explicit LIMITATION declaration in the certification report.
decision: M45.16 enterprise threshold policy is defined and currently satisfied. Policy enforcement is the responsibility of M45.24 (final certification).
